cohort_summary: First-timers (5) understood the core idea quickly thanks to the one-line 'New here?' banner and a solid glossary, and found search, the player panel and URL-encoded filters genuinely good; but the first question every betting-literate visitor asked was 'vs what price?', and the Guide opens by saying nothing here is a price or pick. Jargon (FROZEN, BASE, pts, reads, 'Rank reads for') lives only in a modal, the hint shows only on Home, and the trust surfaces (single-slate Scorecard, BASE placeholders, SAMPLE-DATA feed) don't yet close the deal. Returning trackers (5) hit a harder wall: the star is a same-day watch flag (batter or game only, not a market, no pitcher props), pins are silently deleted after the slate, there is no date navigation (?date ignored) and no pick record, alerts only fire with the tab open, the watchlist is device-local, single picks can't be deep-linked or shared, and Export CSV is a one-market dump of today's board. Median NPS 5; nobody failed to understand the product, but almost nobody could complete a tracking workflow.

personas.name: Grace Lindqvist
personas.profile: Pro (former trader), $25k bankroll, 1u=$250; Pinnacle, Circa, Kalshi; season-long tracking of model vs her own; desktop + phone
personas.goal: Returning user: keep a running record of the board's top-lift reads she follows over the season and pull it into her notebook.
journey: Exports today's 1+ Hit and 1+ HR CSVs separately — two files, one per market.
Looks for past-date export or a season CSV of graded reads — none; Data Feed has no export.
Searches a pitcher not on today's slate to check his history — 'Nothing on today's slate matches'.
Opens the app on her phone; her starred list from desktop isn't there.
Appreciates Predictions calibration tiles (7-day) but can't widen or export them.
personas.quote: The data's clearly there server-side — just let me pull a date range of graded reads and sync my stars across devices.

pain_points.title: Export CSV dumps the filtered board for one market — no odds, no starred-only, no multi-market card, hidden on picks you made
pain_points.detail: Export is today-only and one market at a time; no historical/graded export.
pain_points.evidence: pitchhawk-hr-2026-10-10.csv header: rank,player,team,slot,opposing_starter,game,status,probability,league_rate,lift_pts,xpa,form_30d_rate,result (frontend/pitchhawk.js:1017-1054)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add 'Export my card' (starred picks across markets, with date, line/price/stake columns) and a date-range export of past graded reads for personal tracking sheets.

pain_points.title: Search only finds players on today's slate — no lookup of a player/team history or a pitcher not starting today
pain_points.detail: Search can't reach off-slate players or history.
pain_points.evidence: Search 'skenes' -> 'Nothing on today's slate matches' (frontend/copy.js:111, pitchhawk.js:4335-4357)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Return off-slate players with their next game and recent graded reads; let search jump to past dates once date nav exists.

pain_points.title: Watchlist lives in localStorage — desktop pins don't exist on phone, and clearing site data loses them
pain_points.detail: Watchlist doesn't sync desktop<->phone.
pain_points.evidence: frontend/pitchhawk.js:31 PINS_KEY 'ph-watch' in localStorage; no account/login anywhere
pain_points.suggested_fix: Lightweight account (magic link) or a 'sync code'/share-link that carries the card to another device.

pain_points.title: No way to view yesterday's (or any past) board or picks; ?date= is silently ignored
pain_points.detail: No past-date navigation to reconstruct a day.
pain_points.evidence: #/pred?date=2026-10-09 and #/home?date=2026-10-09 both render today (Oct 10); routeOf has no date param (frontend/pitchhawk.js:270-298); yesterday exists only as 2 aggregate lines in the Scorecard (pitchhawk.js:2006-2017)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add a date stepper (‹ Yesterday · Today · Tomorrow ›) on Home and Predictions, encode it as ?date=YYYY-MM-DD, and show graded results (hit/miss chips) for past slates.

delights: CSV includes league_rate, lift, xPA, form and result — analyst-friendly
Calibration tiles with 'small sample' caveat
Responsible-gambling footer is present but unobtrusive

top_cohort_issues.title: No sportsbook line, price or edge next to any prop read
top_cohort_issues.fix: Show best-available American odds, implied/no-vig prob and edge (model − no-vig) per prop row; sort by edge; label 'no line' explicitly when a book has none.

top_cohort_issues.title: No way to view yesterday's (or any past) board or picks; ?date= is silently ignored
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a date stepper (‹ Yesterday · Today · Tomorrow ›) on Home and Predictions, encode it as ?date=YYYY-MM-DD, and show graded results (hit/miss chips) for past slates.

top_cohort_issues.title: Starred batters/games silently disappear once their slate passes — no record of what you watched
top_cohort_issues.fix: Move expired pins into a 'My past picks' list with their graded result instead of deleting them.

top_cohort_issues.title: Export CSV dumps the filtered board for one market — no odds, no starred-only, no multi-market card, hidden on picks you made
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'Export my card' (starred picks across markets, with date, line/price/stake columns) and a date-range export of past graded reads for personal tracking sheets.

top_cohort_issues.title: URL keeps tab filters but not an opened row, player panel or a specific pick; no share button or shareable card
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add 'Share' on a player row/overlay that copies a deep link (#/pred?m=hr&player=<id>) and a text/image snippet ('Judge 1+ HR · model 23% · league 13%') for Discord/X.

top_cohort_issues.title: Lift / pts / xPA / BASE / FROZEN / 'reads' / 'Rank reads for' are only defined inside a modal
top_cohort_issues.fix: Make every tag (FROZEN, BASE, LINEUP ✓, lift pills, 'pts') a tooltip/tap-target that shows its glossary line; rename 'reads' -> 'model %' and 'pts' -> 'pp vs league' at least on first visit; add a one-line caption to the Pregame/Live ranking toggle.

top_cohort_issues.title: On phone the WATCHING row runs off-screen; the Alerts toggle is hidden behind horizontal scroll and the toast covers the first card
top_cohort_issues.fix: On phone collapse Watching into a count chip ('★ 2') that opens a sheet with the pills and the alerts toggle; auto-dismiss the toast.

top_cohort_issues.title: BASE tag openly calls several props placeholders, mixed in with trained reads at equal visual weight
top_cohort_issues.fix: Visually demote BASE values (muted, no lift pill), group them under 'experimental', and show their own graded record so a user can decide whether to trust them.

top_cohort_issues.title: Star is a watch flag, not a pick: no market, line, odds, stake, result or running record
top_cohort_issues.fix: Turn ★ into 'Add to card': capture market + side + price (manual entry ok) + units; a 'My card' view with auto-grading from the existing result field, daily/season record, units, ROI and CLV if a closing line exists.

top_cohort_issues.title: Alerts only fire while the tab is open; denied permission falls back to an in-page toast
top_cohort_issues.fix: Offer real push (PWA/web push) or email/SMS for pinned players at lineup-posted, on-deck and final; let the user pick which events.

top_cohort_issues.title: Watchlist lives in localStorage — desktop pins don't exist on phone, and clearing site data loses them
top_cohort_issues.fix: Lightweight account (magic link) or a 'sync code'/share-link that carries the card to another device.

top_cohort_issues.title: Scorecard / calibration tiles give raw landed-vs-predicted with no verdict, sample-size or link to the full record
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a verdict line ('ran cold vs model, n=27, within/outside expected range'), a 'see full record ›' link to Data Feed with the same market/day, and a season-to-date row so one bad slate is not the first trust signal.

top_cohort_issues.title: Starter props (Ks, Outs, ER…) cannot be starred at all
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a p:<id>:<market> pin type and star buttons on Starters rows and the starter overlay.

top_cohort_issues.title: Guide opens with 'Nothing here is a price or a pick' to an audience that came to make picks
top_cohort_issues.fix: Keep the compliance line in the footer, but lead the Guide with a 30-second 'how to turn a read into a pick': read -> compare to the book's implied % -> edge. Add a short 'what Pitch Hawk is / isn't' section rather than opening with a negative.

top_cohort_issues.title: Data Feed track record is labelled SAMPLE DATA — the main long-run trust surface is not real here
top_cohort_issues.fix: Ship /graded so the record is real; until then link Home Scorecard to the per-day accuracy that is real rather than a fixture.

top_cohort_issues.title: 'New here?' banner only renders on Home; deep links into Predictions/Live get no orientation
top_cohort_issues.fix: Render the hint (dismissed once, globally) on whichever tab a first-time visitor lands on, with tab-specific copy (e.g. on Predictions: 'Ranked by lift = model % minus league %').

top_cohort_issues.title: Predictions has no 'starred only' filter, so building a card means scanning 25+ rows each visit
top_cohort_issues.fix: Add a '★ My card' status chip on Predictions and include it in CSV export.

top_cohort_issues.title: Pinning Judge from the 1+ HR board stores the batter, not the 1+ HR pick; the pill shows whichever market has higher lift
top_cohort_issues.fix: Store pins as b:<id>:<market> and show exactly the market the user starred.

top_cohort_issues.title: 'RANK READS FOR Pregame | Live' toggle defaults to Live and is unexplained; first-timers can't tell what it changes
top_cohort_issues.fix: Label it 'Show: Pregame picks / In-game calls' with a one-line caption, and default to Pregame before the first game starts.

top_cohort_issues.title: Search only finds players on today's slate — no lookup of a player/team history or a pitcher not starting today
top_cohort_issues.fix: Return off-slate players with their next game and recent graded reads; let search jump to past dates once date nav exists.
